name: Bug Report
about: Report a bug to help us improve

## Bug description
Clearly describe the bug you encountered. Before filing, check the
[troubleshooting guide](https://github.com/stacklok/mecatl/blob/main/docs/usage/troubleshooting.md) for known operator
issues.

## Steps to reproduce
Provide steps or commands needed to reproduce the issue.

## Expected behavior
Explain what you expected to happen.

## Actual behavior
Explain what actually happened.

## Environment (if relevant)
- OS/version:
- mecatl version or commit:
- Deployment shape (embedded engine, mecated, mecak8s, mecatequi, or mecatui):

## Additional context
Any additional information or logs you think might help. Do not include secrets.
